semantic_models.name: dim_date
semantic_models.description: One row per UTC day from 2025-10-01 to 2026-12-31, placed relative to that year's release Thursday.

semantic_models.name: fct_day_off_index
semantic_models.description: The Day-Off Index, one row per window, with its breakdown.

semantic_models.name: fct_day_off_index_terms
semantic_models.description: The Day-Off Index breakdown: one row per search phrase.

semantic_models.name: fct_signal_daily
semantic_models.description: One row per signal per UTC day inside the study and control windows, with its place relative to release.

semantic_models.name: fct_wait_milestones
semantic_models.description: Metric 3: the milestones of the wait between GTA 5 and GTA 6 (editorial picks, one public source each), each with the world real output made since GTA 5 by the day before it. One row per milestone. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.

semantic_models.name: fct_world_output_daily
semantic_models.description: Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: world real output on each UTC day from GTA 5's release (2013-09-17) to the day before GTA 6's (2026-11-18), and the running total since GTA 5. One row per day. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.

semantic_models.name: fct_world_productivity
semantic_models.description: Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6: world productivity per year from 2013 to 2026 and its real change since GTA 5's launch year. One row per measure per year.

metrics.name: day_off_index
metrics.label: Day-Off Index
metrics.description: Average year-over-year change, in percent, of US Google searches for call in sick, sick day and day off work over the configured window (canonical: 1-14 Nov 2026 vs 2-15 Nov 2025). 50 = searches up 50% on average. Never report it alone: always with its breakdown (group by day_off_index_window__breakdown, or query day_off_index_term_change by day_off_index_term__term).

metrics.name: day_off_index_term_change
metrics.label: Day-Off Index, change by phrase
metrics.description: The breakdown: one phrase's year-over-year change in average weekly search interest, in percent. Group by day_off_index_term__term.

metrics.name: day_off_index_term_current
metrics.label: Search interest, current window
metrics.description: A phrase's average weekly search interest over the current window (0-100 on that phrase's own scale). Group by day_off_index_term__term.

metrics.name: day_off_index_term_prior
metrics.label: Search interest, a year earlier
metrics.description: A phrase's average weekly search interest over the same weeks a year earlier (0-100 on that phrase's own scale). Group by day_off_index_term__term.

metrics.name: signal_value
metrics.label: Signal value
metrics.description: Daily value of a signal. Always group by signal_day__source and signal_day__signal; never add across signals.

metrics.name: day_off_mentions
metrics.label: Day-off mentions
metrics.description: Posts saying someone is taking time off (any reason), summed over seed phrases. Group by signal_day__source.

metrics.name: day_off_mentions_gta
metrics.label: Day-off mentions that say GTA
metrics.description: Posts saying someone is taking time off that also mention GTA.

metrics.name: gta_share_of_day_off_talk
metrics.label: GTA share of day-off talk
metrics.description: Day-off posts that mention GTA, as a share of all day-off posts. A fraction (0 to 1). Thursday-is-chattier effects cancel out.

metrics.name: world_output_cumulative
metrics.label: World output since GTA 5, running total
metrics.description: Metric 3. Running total of world real output since GTA 5's release, as of each day. Group by world_output_day__output_day or metric_time; at week or month grain it reads the period's last day. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.

metrics.name: world_productivity_change_since_gta_v
metrics.label: World productivity, change since GTA 5
metrics.description: Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6. Real change in world productivity since GTA 5's launch year (2013), in percent. Group by world_productivity_key__measure and world_productivity_key__data_year. The headline year is 2026 (GTA 6) for output_per_person, an estimate carried by IMF world real GDP growth, and the latest published year for output_per_worker (2026 reads NULL: unavailable).

metrics.name: world_output_per_second
metrics.label: World output per second
metrics.description: Metric 3. The rate the world makes things at: one day's world real output / 86,400. Only meaningful by day: group by world_output_day__output_day (or metric_time__day). A yearly average spread evenly; nobody measures GDP by the second. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.

metrics.name: world_output_produced
metrics.label: World output made while waiting for GTA 6
metrics.description: Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6. World real output (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.KD) made over the days asked for. With no group-by it is the headline: everything made from GTA 5's release (17 Sep 2013) to the day before GTA 6 (18 Nov 2026), 4,811 days. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.

metrics.name: world_productivity
metrics.label: World productivity
metrics.description: Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6. World real output in one year, in the measure's unit: output_per_worker is World Bank GDP per person employed (constant 2021 PPP $), output_per_person is World Bank GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$). Always group by world_productivity_key__measure and world_productivity_key__data_year; never add across measures or years.

metrics.name: gta_wiki_pageviews
metrics.label: GTA 6 Wikipedia pageviews
metrics.description: Daily user pageviews of the English Wikipedia article Grand Theft Auto VI. The hype line.

metrics.name: wait_milestone_output
metrics.label: World output made by each milestone
metrics.description: Metric 3. World real output made since GTA 5's release by the day before each milestone. Group by milestone__title and milestone__event_date (milestone__is_editorial = true for the chart). Milestones are editorial picks, not a ranking. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.

metrics.name: wait_milestone_days_to_gta_6
metrics.label: Days from each milestone to GTA 6
metrics.description: Metric 3. Days from the milestone to GTA 6's release day (19 Nov 2026). Group by milestone.

metrics.name: wait_milestone_share
metrics.label: Share of the wait's output made by each milestone
metrics.description: Metric 3. wait_milestone_output over the whole wait's output (0 to 1). Group by milestone.

dimensions.name: day_off_index_window__breakdown
dimensions.description: Every phrase's change. Always report it with the index.

dimensions.name: milestone__category
dimensions.description: Theme; rockstar marks the Rockstar nods.

dimensions.name: milestone__is_editorial
dimensions.description: True for the editorial milestones, the ones the Metric 3 chart draws.

dimensions.name: milestone__source_url
dimensions.description: One public source for the date.

dimensions.name: milestone__tier
dimensions.description: anchor (the two releases), hero (headline moments) or long.

dimensions.name: signal_day__signal
dimensions.description: What is counted, e.g. posts:day_off, posts:day_off_gta, pageviews:grand_theft_auto_vi.

dimensions.name: signal_day__signal_family
dimensions.description: day_off_intent (people saying or searching they are off), day_off_gta (the same, mentioning GTA), hype (interest in GTA itself), reference.

dimensions.name: world_output_day__is_estimate
dimensions.description: True when the day's year is carried by IMF growth (2026).

dimensions.name: world_productivity_key__launch
dimensions.description: GTA 5 on 2013, GTA 6 on 2026, NULL in between.

dimensions.name: world_productivity_key__year_start
dimensions.description: 1 January of data_year: the time axis.

measures.name: cumulative_output
measures.description: Running total of world real output since GTA 5's release, through the day. Never sum it across days.

measures.name: daily_output
measures.description: World real output made on the day, constant 2015 US$ (the year spread evenly).

measures.name: day_off_index_measure
measures.description: Average YoY change of the phrases, in percent.

measures.name: days_to_gta_6
measures.description: Days from the event to GTA 6's release day.

measures.name: output_by_then
measures.description: World real output made from GTA 5's release through the day before the event, constant 2015 US$.

measures.name: pct_change_since_gta_v
measures.description: Real change since GTA 5's launch year, in percent.

measures.name: share_of_wait_output
measures.description: output_by_then over the whole wait's output (0 to 1).

measures.name: signal_value_measure
measures.description: Daily value of a signal. Counts for posts and pageviews, 0-100 relative interest for Trends. Only meaningful grouped by source, signal and geo; never add across signals.

measures.name: value
measures.description: Real output in the measure's unit.
